offers_products.reason: Sells Bath & Body Works body care, fragrance, candles, soaps, and White Barn home fragrance products.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from goods sold in stores and online, not work performed for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Shoppers buy body care, candles and fragrance through its stores and website.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to international partners/franchisees who resell its products, a minor wholesale channel.

recurring_revenue.reason: Loyal shoppers repeatedly buy consumable soaps, lotions and fragrance, though without contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary fragrance, candles and body care gifts can be cut or postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Candles, soaps, body care and home fragrance are low-priced, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for branded personal care and home fragrance goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual shoppers; small wholesale/international partners are minor.

asset_heavy.reason: Leases mall and standalone stores; outsources much manufacturing; retail footprint needs some capex but not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Based on general knowledge of the retailer; international partner wholesale/franchise is a small part.
